subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A x B' means ‘A is the son of B’,

'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A + B' means ‘A is the wife of B’,

'A % B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to T if ‘M x N % P – S + T’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 ×
 –
 +
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: M x N % P – S + T

M x N → M is the son of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1b3b0c205476b131f473d61d78356e6c7398041c8c4c232f66272c4f532cd3f.png] 

N % P → N is the father of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/949935ef4d9880036518c4785106d35b5b08aa6883215f90a77ca7afa9efd894.png] 

P – S → P is the brother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80d3aa26da1315c0cfe81d6a07abc04ed389a09b2380709bb63280bfd817f880.png] 

S + T → S is the wife of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/621b274c4dad26231b3b9812eed9f4dc1fb4c3b83955b0c9f529ad1bbc5a0669.png] 

Thus, M is T's brother-in-law or wife's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
